ayahs.2: Waada kiye hue din ki qasam!
ayahs.3: Haazir hone wale aur haazir kiye gaye ki qasam!
ayahs.5: Woh ek aag thi indhan wali.
ayahs.6: Jab ke woh log is ke aas paas baithe the.
ayahs.7: Aur musalmaanon ke saath jo kar rahe the us ko apne saamne dekh rahe the.
ayahs.8: Yeh log un musalmaanon (ke kisi aur gunaah ka) badla nahi le rahe the, siwaaye is ke ke woh Allah ghalib laayaq-e-hamd ki zaat par imaan laaye the.
ayahs.9: Jis ke liye aasmaan-o-zameen ka mulk hai. Aur Allah Taala har cheez ko dekh raha hai.
ayahs.10: Beshak jin logon ne musalmaan mardon aur aurton ko sataaya phir tauba (bhi) na ki to un ke liye jahannam ka azaab hai aur jalne ka azaab hai.
ayahs.11: Beshak imaan qabool karne walon aur nek kaam karne walon ke liye woh baaghaat hain, jin ke neeche nahrein beh rahi hain. Yehi badi kaamyaabi hai.
ayahs.12: Yaqeenan tere Rabb ki pakad badi sakht hai.
ayahs.13: Wohi pehli martaba paida karta hai aur wohi dobaara paida karega.
ayahs.14: Woh bada bakhshish karne wala aur bahut mohabbat karne wala hai.
ayahs.15: Arsh ka maalik azmat wala hai.
ayahs.16: Jo chaahe use kar guzarne wala hai.
ayahs.17: Tujhe lashkaron ki khabar bhi mili hai?
ayahs.19: (Kuch nahi) balke kaafir to jhutlaane mein pade hue hain.
ayahs.20: Aur Allah Taala bhi unhein har taraf se ghere hue hai.
ayahs.21: Balke yeh Quran hai badi shaan wala.
